purpose: Pile up two causes of an overwhelming situation.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
Plain clause + わ … + わで + result
It was raining and windy, so a walk was out of the question.
My key was missing and my phone died, leaving me at a loss.
The child cried and the dog barked, so I could not sleep.
formation: Plain clause + わ … + わで + result
restrictions: Often lists troubles or surprises; multiple causes reinforce the result.
mistake: This paired listing differs from the single sentence-ending わ.
